subject: The Reality Stone
body:
Someone keeps leaving the same note in the book, in different handwriting each time: throw the light upward while you fall.

I think I've worked it out. Fall out of the bottom of a pocket room behind a dimensional door and you end up in Limbo. Once you're there, throw a Lucid Pearl while you're falling. It won't land, and you'll keep going down. The Reality Stone is at the bottom.

I have no idea what awaits you afterward. But I am ever so curious.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
